description: A generic content embed block. Renders an optional heading and passes content through do_shortcode(). Use for WP plugin shortcodes (contact forms, calendars, etc.) that belong to WP rather than to the PromptingPress composition model. This is the only sanctioned way to introduce arbitrary content into a composition.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Optional section heading above the embedded content.

content.description: WP shortcode string or pre-rendered HTML. Passed through do_shortcode() and wp_kses_post(). Example: '[contact-form-7 id="123"]'.

variant.description: Background presentation. 'default' = page background. 'dark' = surface background with borders. 'inverted' = inverted background for strong contrast.

spacing.description: Vertical padding override. 'compact' tightens padding. 'spacious' adds extra breathing room. 'default' uses the component's built-in padding (subject to CSS rhythm defaults).

width.description: Content width override. 'narrow' constrains to 56rem. 'full' stretches to viewport (with padding). 'default' uses the standard max-width.
